setup.title: Site Setup

admin.title: Administration
admin.login_lead: Sign in to manage site settings.
admin.login_required: Please sign in to access the admin panel.
admin.invalid_password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
admin.active_theme_invalid: Active theme must be one of the enabled themes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Players with last activity in the selected window (from character last play time).

logs.lead: Browse game server logs. Filter by text or date range.
logs.missing_table: This log table is not available on the game database.
logs.connections_lead: IP addresses used to log in to game accounts, from loginlog2.
logs.connections_search_placeholder: Search by IP, login, or account ID

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lead: Create, edit, block, and delete game accounts.
accounts.create_lead: Create a game account that can log in on the site and in the client.
accounts.edit_lead: Update account details, cash, or status. Leave password and PIN blank to keep the current values.
accounts.invalid_currency: Cash and mileage must be zero or greater.
accounts.password_keep: Leave blank to keep the current password.
accounts.social_id_keep: Leave blank to keep the current PIN.
accounts.ips_help: IP addresses used to log in on this account, from loginlog2.
accounts.ips_empty: No connection IPs recorded for this account yet.
accounts.confirm_delete: Delete this account? This cannot be undone.
accounts.details_help: Login and email used on the site. Password and PIN follow the game client rules.
accounts.state_help: Blocked accounts cannot log in. Cash and mileage are written to the game account table.
accounts.characters_empty: No characters on this account yet.
accounts.danger_help: Blocking prevents login. Deleting removes the account row only.

characters.title: Characters
characters.lead: Browse game characters. Stats are shown as read-only.
characters.view_lead: Character details from the game database. Stats cannot be changed here.
characters.name: Name
characters.details_help: Values come from the player table and are not editable in this panel.
characters.logs_help: Recent rows from log tables that mention this character.
characters.logs_empty: No log rows found for this character.
characters.items_help: Equipment, inventory, dragon soul, and account safebox shown as in the client.
characters.safebox_help: Safebox yang and pages from the safebox table. Items with window SAFEBOX or MALL belong to the account.
characters.safebox_empty: This account has no safebox row or stored items.
characters.safebox_items_empty: No items stored in the safebox or mall.
characters.guild_help: Guild data from guild, guild_member, and guild_grade.
characters.guild_empty: This character is not in a guild.
characters.marriage_help: Marriage row from the marriage table, if this character is engaged or married.
characters.marriage_empty: This character is not engaged or married.

owned_items.lead: This unique item ID and the log rows that mention it.
owned_items.details_help: Current row from the player item table. The vnum is the proto; the ID is this instance.
owned_items.missing: This item is no longer in the player database. Logs below still use this ID.
owned_items.logs_help: Cube, refine, and item/character log rows for this unique ID.
owned_items.logs_empty: No log rows found for this item ID.

proto.vnum_taken: That vnum is already in use.
proto.invalid_vnum: Vnum must be a positive number.
proto.missing_files: Game proto files were not found in game/db.
proto.write_failed: Could not write proto files. Check permissions on game/db.

equip.hint_ring: Equips to ring slot 1 or 2 (WEAR_RING1 / WEAR_RING2).
equip.hint_dragon_soul: Dragon soul slot is chosen from DS subtype.
equip.hint_wear_wear_ability: Equips to quest ability slot (fixed once worn).
equip.hint_wear_multi: Multiple wear flags — first matching empty slot is used.

items.title: Items
items.lead: Create and edit item proto rows from game/db/item_proto.txt and item_names_en.txt.
items.create_lead: Add a vnum to the item proto and English names files.
items.edit_lead: Changes are written to the proto and names files. Internal Korean names stay unchanged.
items.search_placeholder: Search by vnum, name, or type
items.confirm_delete: Delete this item from the proto files?
items.danger_help: Deleting removes the row from item_proto.txt and item_names_en.txt.

mobs.title: Mobs
mobs.lead: Create and edit mob proto rows from game/db/mob_proto.txt and mob_names_en.txt.
mobs.create_lead: Add a vnum to the mob proto and English names files.
mobs.edit_lead: Changes are written to the proto and names files. Internal Korean names stay unchanged.
mobs.search_placeholder: Search by vnum, name, type, or rank
mobs.confirm_delete: Delete this mob from the proto files?
mobs.danger_help: Deleting removes the row from mob_proto.txt and mob_names_en.txt.
mobs.drops_help: Groups from game/server/mob_drop_item.txt and drop_item_group.txt for this vnum.
mobs.drops_empty: No specific drop groups for this mob.
mobs.common_help: Rank-based rows from common_drop_item.txt whose level range includes this mob's level. The game rolls them against the killer's level.
mobs.common_empty: No common drops for this rank and level range.
mobs.groups_help: Entries in group.txt that include this mob, plus group_group.txt packs that reference them.
mobs.groups_empty: This mob is not in any spawn group.

guilds.title: Guilds
guilds.lead: Browse and manage player guilds. Changes apply on the next game reload.
guilds.search_placeholder: Search by name, master, or ID
guilds.name: Name
guilds.details_help: Safe fields only. Master, skills, and creation stay in-game.
guilds.confirm_dissolve: Dissolve this guild and remove all members?

gms.title: Game masters
gms.lead: Manage common.gmlist and allowed GM hosts. The game core may cache these on boot.
gms.create_lead: Grant GM authority to an existing game account.
gms.edit_lead: Update GM name, authority, and IP restrictions.
gms.name: Character name
gms.details_help: Account must already exist in account.account.
gms.hosts_help: IPs allowed to connect as GM (gmhost). Use *.*.*.* to allow all.

awards.title: Item awards
awards.lead: Queue items for the item mall or account safebox (item_award).
awards.create_lead: Creates a pending award row. The player collects it in-game.
awards.pid_help: Optional. Must belong to the account.
awards.details_help: Pending awards can be deleted before the player collects them.
awards.delete_failed: Could not delete award (already collected or missing).
awards.invalid_pid: Character does not belong to this account.
awards.item_not_found: Item vnum not found in proto.

shops.title: Shops
shops.edit_lead: Edit shop NPC and item list.
shops.name: Name
shops.item_exists: This item/count pair already exists in the shop.
shops.confirm_delete: Delete this shop and all its items?
shops.confirm_remove_item: Remove this item from the shop?

refine.title: Refine recipes
refine.create_lead: Define materials, cost, and success rate.
refine.search_placeholder: Recipe ID, used-by vnum, or material vnum (prefix)
refine.item_not_found: One or more item vnums were not found.

drops.title: Drop files
drops.lead: Edit server drop text files under game/server/. Reload the game to apply.
drops.etc_lead: Edit etc_drop_item.txt (name and chance per line).
drops.common_help: A .bak backup is created on first save. Empty item_ref rows are skipped.
drops.mob_lead: Edit mob_drop_item.txt groups for this mob.
drops.mob_section_help: Edit groups tied to a mob vnum in mob_drop_item.txt.
drops.reload_help: Changes are written to disk. Use /reload or restart the game server to apply.
drops.common_header_missing: Could not read common_drop_item header row.
drops.mob_empty: No drop groups for this mob yet.
drops.label: Label

registration.title: Registrations
registration.lead: Control whether new player accounts can be created on the site.
registration.enable_help: When disabled, the register page shows a closed message and no signup form.

themes.title: Themes
themes.lead: Choose which themes are available and which one is active on the site.
themes.available_help: Visitors can only switch between themes you enable here.
themes.active_help: The theme shown to visitors by default.

locale.title: Default language
locale.lead: Default language for visitors without a saved preference.
